FAQ.title: Help Center & FAQ
FAQ.a1: Every address and every received email is automatically purged from our system after exactly 60 minutes. This ensures that no legacy data remains on our servers for prying eyes.
FAQ.a2: Yes, DisposeMail is a forever-free tool powered by high-quality ads to keep our infrastructure growing.
FAQ.a3: DisposeMail is a privacy-first utility that provides instant temporary email addresses. These are used to protect your real identity and primary inbox from junk mail, spam, and data-gathering websites.
FAQ.a4: Yes. Using a temporary email is a perfectly legal and common method of protecting online privacy and reducing spam.
FAQ.a5: No. Once an email is deleted (either manually or by the 60-minute timer), it is permanently wiped from our RAM-based storage. We do not keep backups or archival data.
FAQ.a6: Some websites maintain 'blacklists' of common temporary email domains. By providing multiple domains, we allow you to skip these restrictions and sign up for services that might block others.
FAQ.a7: Yes, our system parses full MIME content. While we focus on making the text and HTML content readable, we also allow you to see and process message structures completely.
FAQ.a8: People often search for disposalmail, disposal temp mail, disposmail, or dispose mail. Whether you type disposalmail.com or disposemail.xyz, you're looking for a secure temporary email. We are officially DisposeMail, but we provide the disposal mail services you need.
FAQ.q9: Do I need to refresh the page to see new emails?
FAQ.a9: No! Our Zero-Loss architecture uses real-time WebSockets. As soon as an email hits our server, it is instantly pushed to your browser screen without a single refresh.
FAQ.q10: Can I recover an address after it expires?
FAQ.a10: Absolutely not. To guarantee your privacy, once an address or email reaches the 60-minute limit (or you click Burn Inbox), it is permanently wiped from our RAM-based database. We keep zero backups.
FAQ.a11: While we parse and display attachments, you should always exercise extreme caution when opening files from unknown senders. We recommend only downloading attachments if you are explicitly expecting them (like an invoice or ticket).
FAQ.support_desc: Our goal is to provide the most reliable temporary email service on the web. If you're experiencing issues or have suggestions, our community is here to help.
FAQ.q12: How can I create a temporary email address?
FAQ.a12: Simply visit our homepage and a secure, random temporary email address is instantly generated for you. No signup required.
FAQ.q13: What are the best free services for disposable email?
FAQ.a13: DisposeMail is widely considered one of the best free services because we offer premium features like custom domains, real-time WebSockets, and complete zero-log privacy at absolutely no cost.
FAQ.q14: How do temporary email services work?
FAQ.a14: Our platform provisions a temporary inbox on our secure servers. When an email targets that address, it is processed in memory and pushed seamlessly to your browser, before being permanently deleted after 1 hour.

About.title: About DisposeMail
About.mission_desc: In an age of constant surveillance and data breaches, DisposeMail was built with a single mission: to protect your primary inbox and personal identity. We believe that privacy is a fundamental human right, not a luxury. Our service provides a temporary shield between your real self and the vast, often tracking-heavy world of the internet.
About.why_exist_desc: Every time you sign up for a newsletter, trial, or app, you risk exposing your email to spammers, trackers, and potential cybercriminals. Once your email is on a 'list,' it's there forever. DisposeMail provides an instant, secure buffer that allows you to access the web without the long-term baggage of spam.
About.tech_desc: We utilize modern cloud infrastructure leveraging Cloudflare Edge networks and secure VPS nodes to route emails instantly. Unlike other providers, we don't store your data in a persistent database. Our high-performance WebSocket architecture ensures that when an email arrives, it's displayed on your screen in real-time.
About.item1: Zero Logs: We don't log IP addresses or user agents.
About.item2: Auto-Purge: Every bit of data is shredded every 60 minutes.
About.item3: No Registration: We don't ask for your name, phone number, or real email.
About.item4: Encrypted: All traffic is served over SSL/TLS for maximum security.
About.transparency_desc: We believe privacy tools should be transparent. While we operate a complex infrastructure to maintain speed and reliability, we are committed to remaining an open and community-focused platform. If you have questions about how our service works, feel free to reach out to our team.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.sec1_desc: Your privacy is our core principle. As a zero-knowledge disposable email service, we collect absolutely no personally identifiable information (PII) during your visit. We do not require registration, passwords, or personal email addresses. The temporary email address generated for you is cryptographically random and cannot be linked back to your true identity.
Privacy.sec2_desc: We operate strictly entirely in-memory. Emails received by your temporary inbox are delivered instantly via WebSocket and are never written to a database or physical disk. Once you close your browser tab or your session expires, the cryptographic link to the inbox is broken, and all received data evaporated instantly and permanently.
Privacy.sec3_desc: To keep our premium security features completely free forever, we display advertisements provided by our third-party partner, Monetag. Monetag may use standard tracking technologies such as cookies and local storage to deliver personalized and relevant ads based on browsing habits. By using our service and accepting our cookie consent banner, you agree to the placement of these advertising cookies. You may opt-out of personalized advertising through your browser settings at any time.
Privacy.sec4_desc: To protect our infrastructure and ensure the service remains reliable for all legitimate users, we utilize automated security systems (including Cloudflare and custom in-memory rate limiters). These systems temporarily log obfuscated IP addresses strictly for the purpose of mitigating DDoS attacks, brute-force attempts, and spam generation. These security logs are routinely purged and are never used to track user behavior or sold to third parties.
Privacy.sec5_desc: Because we operate a genuine zero-knowledge architecture and do not store historical email data, we physically cannot comply with requests to retrieve past emails. If legally compelled by a binding court order, we can only provide real-time connection telemetry (if available), but we maintain no retroactive data regarding our users' activities.
